name: E&O
recent: 近期公告主要是董事及大股东 Tee 家族通过 Amazing Parade Sdn Bhd 在公开市场持续增持公司股份，以及相关的持股变动申报。新闻方面，市场关注公司依托槟城增长在 FY2027 实现 RM1b 物业销售的目标。
notable: 执行主席 Dato' Seri Tee Eng Ho 与执行董事 Dato' Tee Eng Seng 通过 Amazing Parade Sdn Bhd 在公开市场多次增持公司股份。
公司提出依托槟城增长在 FY2027 实现 RM1b 物业销售的目标。
risks: 董事及大股东在闭门期前后持续申报买卖，需留意后续股权变动。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为 MYR281.471m，环比增长19.3%，同比增长53.4%；净利为 MYR58.111m，环比下降6.3%，同比增长27.9%；净利率为20.6%，低于上一季度的26.3%。

recent_en: Recent announcements mainly involve continued open-market acquisitions by the Tee family and Amazing Parade Sdn Bhd, along with related shareholding disclosures. In the news, focus is on the company's target of RM1b property sales for FY2027, backed by Penang growth.
notable_en: Executive Chairman Dato' Seri Tee Eng Ho and Executive Director Dato' Tee Eng Seng, via Amazing Parade Sdn Bhd, acquired shares in the company through multiple open-market transactions.
The company targets RM1b in property sales for FY2027, backed by Penang growth.
risks_en: Directors and major shareholders have been reporting dealings around the closed period; further shareholding changes should be monitored.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR281.471m, up 19.3% QoQ and 53.4% YoY; net income was MYR58.111m, down 6.3% QoQ but up 27.9% YoY; net margin was 20.6%, lower than 26.3% in the previous quarter.
